title: Factoring noise across the last coordinate
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f\colon\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\mathbb R$, let $\rho\in\mathbb R$, and let $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ and $y\in\{0,1\}^1$. Then $T_\rho f(x,y_0)=T_\rho\bigl(t\mapsto T_\rho(f_t)(x)\bigr)(y)$, where $f_t(z)=f(z,t_0)$ for $t\in\{0,1\}^1$ and $z\in\{0,1\}^n$; the outer noise operator acts on the one-dimensional cube.
replaced: Let $f:\{0,1\}^{n+1}\to\bbr$, $\rho\in\bbr$, and $f_b(z)=f(z,b)$. For $x\in\{0,1\}^n$ and $b\in\{0,1\}$, $T_\rho f(x,b)=T_\rho\bigl(t\mapsto T_\rho f_t(x)\bigr)(b)$; the outer operator acts on one bit and the inner operator on $n$ bits. For $d\in\mathbb N$, $h:\{0,1\}^d\to\bbr$, and $\tau\in\bbr$, the spectral noise operator is $T_\tau h(x)=\sum_{S\subseteq[d]}\tau^{|S|}\widehat h(S)\chi_S(x)$, where $\chi_S(x)=(-1)^{\sum_{i\in S}x_i}$ and $\widehat h(S)=\E[h\chi_S]$ under the uniform measure.
